logline: Man United's standards are a high-jump bar that drops from a treble to a draw on the ground; captain Bruno scores twice and complains louder at every team-mate mishap, Pochettino says 'so proud', and Bruno carries the bar away himself.

beats.idea: 1999: the bar is in the sky — TREBLE — a 1999 jumper flops over it
CLUNK, CLUNK: TOP 4 → ANY TROPHY → EUROPE PLEASE → NOT RELEGATED
now: the bar lies on the ground (A DRAW); captain Bruno (armband) steps up
Bruno's skip-hop run-up twice: two goals
keeper trips over the floor bar → Bruno arms wide; Amad's goal VAR ❌ → hands on head; red card → on his knees crying
Pochettino megaphone: SO PROUD! — Bruno turns to camera, deadpan; crickets
a groundsman digs the bar lower; Bruno lifts it and carries it toward NEXT: Leipzig · Bayern · Villarreal; old fan holds a 1999 photo

twist: the only one who clears the bar is Bruno — so he ends up carrying the bar itself
callback: the 1999 treble from the first shot returns as the old fan's photo
hidden_details: the next three opponents are written on the buried bar
meme_frame: Bruno's arms-wide complaint as the keeper trips over a bar lying on the ground
hook_frame0: cover: MAN UTD'S BAR NOW 📉 — Bruno complaining
